overview.title: Who you are and how you work together
overview.text: Three rooms that build on each other: first you, then the two of you, then your venture. Nothing here is graded. There are no scores and no types. What others see is your decision, part by part.
overview.ringsLabel: Three rooms as circles: Me in the center, around it We, outside Our venture

ich.title: Me
ich.text: How you work, what you can do and what drives you. This belongs to you, no matter who you found with.

wir.title: We
wir.text: Who you found with and how you work together. You only see what each person explicitly shares.

vorhaben.title: Our venture
vorhaben.text: What you are building and what you put in writing together. Your agreements are made here.
vorhaben.noTeam: The venture and your agreements are built with your team. Once you are on a team, you will find them here.

pair.title: As a pair
pair.note: only the two of you see this

work.title: Work style
work.text: Short questions about how you work. Only you see the result until you share it.

can.title: Skills
can.text: Where you are at home and what you want to own yourself.

strengths.title: Discover your strengths
strengths.text: You tell short situations from your life, and we show you what they reveal.

direction.title: Direction
direction.text: What keeps drawing you in, in your own words.

allDone.title: Your profile is complete
allDone.text: You can view and change it any time.

invite.title: Invite a co-founder
invite.text: We starts with a second person. An invitation goes out as a link.

reportReady.title: View the team report
reportReady.text: The shared work style report is ready.

reportWaiting.title: Work style in the team
reportWaiting.text: The shared report is still missing answers or shares. There you can see what is missing.

noTeam.title: A team first
noTeam.text: The venture and your agreements are built with your team.

setupConfirm.title: Confirm agreements
setupConfirm.text: {count} agreements are waiting for your confirmation.

setupStart.title: Start Founder Setup
setupStart.text: This is where you put down how you work together, topic by topic.

teamMap.title: Team map
teamMap.note: Clicking an open field only prepares a search in Find. Find receives nothing from Align.
teamMap.empty: Once you share your skills with the team, your team map appears here.

ich.title: Me
ich.text: Only you, until you share something.

wir.title: We
wir.text: Only what each person explicitly shares.

vorhaben.title: Our venture
vorhaben.text: Everyone on the team. Advisors only with their own permission.

gesamtbild.title: Me, You, Our Startup
gesamtbild.text: Everything from the three rooms in one report. It describes, it does not grade. To read on screen and as a PDF.
